description: Implementation and suite execution look done, but at least one input requirement has no respective test, so the coding agent must not write a completion report.
why_this_matters: The completion report is gated on requirement-to-test coverage, not on a narrative claim that the work is done.

input.user_prompt:
Build requirements/ECCS-12837/plan/plan.md
Go through it step by step and apply each step acceptance criteria in the agent loop.
input.context: handoff.json is READY_FOR_IMPLEMENTATION. functional.md defines REQ-001 and REQ-002. After the planned steps, tests cover REQ-001 only. The coverage gate JSON has passed false and uncovered includes REQ-002.
